errata.reason: D215 original-pixel scope and D215 current independent complete-period derivation confirm a printing error: the short averaging bar excludes the square. For a nonzero zero-mean sinusoid, the square of the signed mean is zero while the mean square is positive. The adjacent RMS definition requires squaring before averaging. Only the exponent's averaging scope is corrected in the modern edition.
